name: Kenco MCS Chattanooga BP2 - Chattanooga TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster gave an APPROXIMATE geocode for 'Chattanooga, TN 37406' that landed on the CSX DeButts rail yard. Web research positively resolved BP2 to 6301 Enterprise Park Dr, Chattanooga TN 37416: Chattanoogan.com/Times Free Press reported a 210,000 SF industrial warehouse on over 12 acres at 6301 Enterprise Park Dr (built 1995) sold for $67.09M in 2022 as part of a Kenco-affiliate 7-warehouse Chattanooga portfolio. 210,000 SF and 12+ acres are an EXACT match for BP2 (210,000 SF on the Kenco warehousing map). 6301 Enterprise Park Dr geocodes ROOFTOP at 35.069286,-85.1764238.
fieldNotes.buildingChoice: High confidence on building identity (210,000 SF / 12+ acres / 6301 Enterprise Park Dr matches BP2 exactly). Overall confidence held to medium because the gate/guard determination relies on imagery interpretation and Street View only reached one building face.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth at the property driveway off Enterprise Park Drive. Open paved loop entrance at the SE corner; Street View (Feb 2026) of the SW wall shows a plain warehouse facade with no gate. Typical leased industrial-park warehouse. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure visible at the entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~26 dock doors along the NE building face from z18/z19 imagery (regular bay rhythm, ~12-15 trailers backed in). Band 25-50; low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~15 trailers staged on the NE apron including drop trailers without tractors; estimated ~22-trailer capacity. Band 10-25.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock activity is on a single NE-face dock bank - shipping and receiving are not on physically separate clusters.

fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south side of the broader Enterprise Park area; no spur enters this parcel.
